pages.text: Lets you leave a sealed base without venting it.

pages.title: Build
pages.text: $(li)Two complete $(bold)Airlock Doors$()$(li)At most $(bold)32$() open interior blocks; 3x3x3 is 27$(li)One controller in a wall, facing the chamber$(br2)Full glass works.

pages.name: Minimal Airlock
pages.text: Roof left off to show inside. One controller, facing the chamber.

pages.title: Cycling
pages.text: Close both doors, then right-click the controller.$(br2)A door opens only when pressure matches on both sides, including vacuum on both. A refused door says why.

pages.title: Lamp
pages.text: $(li)Red: empty$(li)Amber: cycling$(li)Green: air present$(br2)Crouch-click for reserve and chamber O2. One status line shows in your suit HUD or above the hotbar.

pages.title: Inner Door
pages.text: With air on both sides, clicking the inner door equalizes and opens it in one go. Shift-click uses its valve without opening.$(br2)$(danger)If either side is vacuum, use the controller.$()

pages.title: Power
pages.text: Link the controller with the $(l:power/binder)Binder$(/l). Cycling draws $(bold)2 kW$() for 4 s (8 kJ); idle draws nothing. A bank or Cell Dock can run it.

pages.title: Outages
pages.text: Without power both doors stay locked and the cycle pauses until power returns.$(br2)The inner-door valve can still cancel the cycle and share its gas with the base, if both sides have air.$(br2)$(danger)Breaking a wall or door still breaches the room.$()

pages.title: Extra Panels
pages.text: Optional; they share gas and cycling. One controller inside the chamber is enough.$(br2)$(flavor)One atmosphere at a time.$()

pages.title: Airlock Doors
pages.text: Makes two.$(br2)$(flavor)Close the door behind you.$()

pages.title: Emergency Vent
pages.text: Mount facing the chamber. Right-click to dump its air at once: no recovery, no pump.

pages.title: Emergency Vent
pages.text: Flames go out; torches stay as Spent Torches; soul lights remain.$(br2)$(danger)With the inner door open, the base vents too.$() Get on EVA oxygen first.

pages.title: Oxygen
pages.text: Cycling spends real oxygen. See $(l:heating/airlock_oxygen)Airlock Oxygen$(/l).
